verdict.rationale: Paddle documents an official, hosted remote MCP server with separate sandbox and live endpoints. The live endpoint supports OAuth or API key auth, and connections are managed under Paddle > Connectors > MCP. A codemode tool set (search, execute, report_missing_tool) covers the full API, and a separate docs MCP server plus official Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI plugins bundle both servers; a probe confirms the MCP doc page is live. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect and work as documented (the probe only confirms the doc page exists, and the LLM benchmark is first-party), and destructive operations are not gated server-side (mitigation relies on least-permission API keys).
